messages:
ashley (acct-exec): quick escalation — POC customer reports intermittent JSON.parse failures when using function-calling + json_mode (non-streaming). They pasted a raw response with trailing bytes. Can ops/sre/eng swarm?

sam (sales-engineer): Can we get the exact raw HTTP response and whether they retry on 429/500 or reuse connections?

ashley (acct-exec): They said they do retries and keep-alive. Sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "choices": [{"message": {"name": "extract", "arguments": "{\"id\":123}"}}]
}
--trailing-bytes--
```

tyler (ml-eng): Sounds like a TCP/stream boundary issue if client retries on same connection. Need request IDs to map to worker logs.

prashant (infra): Ops-bot, pull traces for any recent 429s from this customer. Also quick mitigation: advise SDK-level dedupe + small client sanitizer.

ops-bot: Trace found: req_x7f9 -> worker-12. Worker log shows WARN "stream-terminate: leftover-bytes" at 2026-03-20T18:04:12Z. Related req: req_x7fa.

tyler (ml-eng): That WARN is likely root cause. Short-term mitigations for customer: 1) use SDK de-dup/idempotency; 2) add a defensive parser that extracts the first JSON object before JSON.parse; 3) consider streaming=true and stream-parse.

sam (sales-engineer): They also asked pricing: if they stop client retries, how much cost saved?

prashant (infra): Rough one-liner: duplicate retries can increase token bill roughly proportional to retry rate (e.g., 10% retry -> up to ~10% extra tokens). SDK de-dup prevents double-charge.

tyler (ml-eng): We'll push a hotfix to the worker shim to append an explicit delimiter to json_mode responses so concatenated payloads are detectable. Patch + tests ~2h, staging run ~2h, 10% canary afterward.

ashley (acct-exec): I'll tell customer: interim SDK sanitizer + pricing note, hotfix in staging today, canary tomorrow. Scheduling a call at 16:00 PT. Will post any raw request ids they send. :thumbsup:
